intro.title: Become a UX designer: step by step
intro.description1: Want to start or grow your UX career? Learn from industry experts at TUKLOGIC, where we combine research-backed methodologies with practical experience.
intro.description2: Our hands-on courses make it easy. Learn online or in-person, in English or Arabic. Explore our digital services to see how we apply these principles in real-world projects.

customized.title: Customized training solutions for your team
customized.description1: In a super competitive digital space, level your employees up with our custom designed Corporate User Experience training. Our Corporate UX training can be tailored to suit your industry, business and employee requirements.
customized.description2: Plan your availability with a customizable course schedule that we can accommodate depending on your needs. Our specialist trainers are professionals in the UX field, and can come to your company, place of business or a dedicated venue arranged by us to present this training. Favoring smaller class sizes, the course ensures quality learning time and dedicated focus on trainees. Ideal for beginners as well as pros, our training highlights practical applications so that the skills and knowledge of this course can be directly used in your industry.
